articles.title: 'Bring it on,' Mississauga mayor says as real estate firms appeal city's data centre ban
articles.summary: Mississauga's new mayor says he's prepared to fight against U.S-based Prologis and Montcrest Asset Management, two companies that are challenging the city's decision to block a data centre project at the Ontario Land Tribunal.

articles.title: Pedestrian taken to hospital with serious injuries after being struck by vehicle in Scarborough
articles.summary: Paramedics tell CityNews they’ve taken a man to a local trauma centre with serious, non life-threatening injuries after he was struck by a vehicle in Scarborough on Tuesday evening. It happened at Ellesmere Road and Mondeo Drive at around 5:39 p.m. Police say the driver remained at the scene. The westbound lanes are currently closed […]

articles.summary: A cadet leader who underwent spinal surgery after a violent attack says he is currently paralyzed from the waist down and will require months of physical rehabilitation. Capt. articles.title: 2 injured in collision between motorcycle and minivan in Mississauga
articles.summary: Two people have been taken to hospital after a collision between a motorcycle and a minivan in Mississauga Tuesday afternoon. articles.summary: Toronto Police Service (TPS) officers have arrested seven people — four men and three women — after a firearms investigation culminated with a raid at a location in the Steeles Avenue West and Keele Street area last month. articles.title: Mississauga data centre moratorium challenged by U.S. real estate giant, Toronto firm
articles.summary: Mississauga's data centre moratorium is set to face a legal challenge, as a U.S. real estate giant and a Toronto asset manager move to overturn the pause at the Ontario Land Tribunal.

articles.title: Inquest into death of Jamal Francique, who was shot by police in Mississauga in 2020 paused for a day
articles.summary: The coroner's inquest into the death of a Black man shot by police in Mississauga, Ont., nearly seven years ago is on hold for a day. The presiding officer says counsel are dealing with the proposed submission of new material not previously provided to the inquest.

articles.title: SIU investigating after Durham police involved in crash at Hwy 401 ramp
articles.summary: A 53-year-old woman has a serious, non-life threatening injury after a three-vehicle collision involving a police vehicle in Whitby on Sunday, the province's police watchdog says.

articles.title: U of T's plan to address discrimination against Muslims, Arabs, Palestinians 'insufficient': prof
articles.summary: The University of Toronto's plans to address discrimination against Muslims, Arabs and Palestinians on its campuses are "wholly insufficient," says the author of a report that found the school has a "general pattern of over-policing and under-protecting" these groups.

articles.title: 12 men charged in Peel auto theft bust after 96 vehicles recovered from shipping containers
articles.summary: Twelve men have been arrested after Peel Regional Police say they recovered 96 stolen vehicles, worth an estimated $4.5 million, from shipping containers destined for West Africa.

articles.title: Inquest into death of Mississauga man shot by police in 2020 hears from Peel constable
articles.summary: A police constable told a coroner's inquest Monday he was concerned about the risk of an ambush as he approached a car that had crashed into a pillar after it was hit by police gunfire during a botched arrest in Mississauga, Ont., nearly seven years ago.
